title: super lightweight, attractive, but flimsy-- Use this for light stuff that doesnt get moved a lot
text:
super lightweight, attractive, but flimsy-- Use this for light stuff that doesnt get moved a lot. Flimsy, even for soft sided storage boxes. It will be fine if you plan to keep the storage box in place, and once filled up it takes on a more sturdy look and feel. But it really isn't a box that can be relied on to move around. Guess it depends on what you will be using it for. I think its ok. And it might be perfect once I find the right application. Even though it is flimsy, it doesn't feel like it is going to fall apart--but I wont be putting heavy or jagged items in there. It just needs a little more structure, or maybe an added piece of cardboard to give it more structure. Tops flips up, and when in down position there is a velcro strap to keep it closed.

I love storage stuff, so these will get used. But right now I have them tucked back in their packaging as I decide where I could actually use it since it isnt as sturdy as others I have. I'm thinking it will come in handy for those looking to organize lightweight stuff. Things like scrunchies and other hair stuff, make up/skin care, clothes closet organization, light weight crafts, etc.

Attractive. When not in use, they store easily and very flat.

3.5 stars-- they are OK. Not terrible, not wonderful.
